```artifact
Feature: Self-Test

  Scenario: Pre-test mode
    Given the controller is in pre-test mode
    When the user initiates the self-test
    Then the system displays the pre-test mode menu

  Scenario: Flow Sensor Accuracy
    Given the blower speed is set to 50%
    And the air lines are open
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is initiated
    Then the flow rate is 5.0 liters per minute
    And the flow rate is within the specified tolerance range

  Scenario: Pressure Sensor Accuracy
    Given the blower speed is set to 50%
    And the air lines are open
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is initiated
    Then the pressure reading is 1013 mbar
    And the pressure reading is within the specified tolerance range

  Scenario Outline: Pre-test mode checks
    Given the controller is in pre-test mode
    When the self-test is initiated
    Then the system checks for:
      | Check | Expected Result |
      | --- | --- |
      | Flow rate | 5.0 liters per minute |
      | Pressure reading | 1013 mbar |
      | Blower speed | 50% |

  Examples:
    | Blower Speed | Flow Rate | Pressure Reading |
    | 0% | 0.0 liters per minute | 1013 mbar |
    | 50% | 5.0 liters per minute | 1013 mbar |
    | 100% | 10.0 liters per minute | 1013 mbar |

  Scenario Outline: Flow Sensor Accuracy - Boundary Values
    Given the blower speed is set to 50%
    And the air lines are open
    And nothing is connected to the output
    When the self-test is initiated
    Then the flow rate is within the specified tolerance range for:
      | Flow Rate | Expected Range |
      | --- | --- |
      | 0.0 liters per minute | 0.0 - 1.0 liters per minute |
      | 5.0 liters per minute | 4.0 - 6.0 liters per minute |
      | 10.0 liters per minute | 9.0 - 11.0 liters per minute |

  Scenario: Error Messages
    Given the controller is in pre-test mode
    When the self-test is initiated with a failing flow or pressure check
    Then the system displays an error message with the exact text "Flow or pressure check failed"

  Scenario Outline: Pre-test mode checks - Negative Coverage
    Given the controller is in pre-test mode
    When the self-test is initiated with a failing flow or pressure check
    Then the system displays an error message with the exact text "Flow or pressure check failed" for:
      | Check | Expected Result |
      | --- | --- |
      | Flow rate | 0.0 liters per minute |
      | Pressure reading | 0 mbar |
```
